meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理当前讨论为规格并发布到项目问题列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们经常在讨论后需要把共识沉淀成正式规格并同步到项目管理工具。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn meeting discussions into a formal spec and share it with your team.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会拿当前对话和代码库的理解,直接综合出一份 spec(PRD),发布到项目的 issue tracker,并打上 ready-for-agent 标签。它不会来访谈你。
howto.when: 当你聊完需求,想把手头的对话固化成规格文档并提交到 issue tracker 时。它需要手动调用,不会自动接管。

say.text: 把我们刚讨论的整理成一份 spec,发到项目 issue tracker 上
根据当前对话写一份 PRD,提交成 issue
say.note: 只综合已经讨论过的内容

say.text: 先把测试接缝列出来跟我确认,再写 spec 发出去
say.note: 发布前会先跟你核对接缝

howto.what_en: After install, it synthesizes the current conversation and codebase understanding into a spec (PRD), publishes it to the project issue tracker, and applies the ready-for-agent label. It does not interview you.
howto.when_en: Use it when you have already discussed the requirements and want that conversation turned into a spec filed on the issue tracker. It is manually invoked, so it does not trigger on its own.

say_en.text: Turn what we just discussed into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker
say_en.note: No interview; it applies the ready-for-agent label

say_en.text: Write a PRD from this conversation and file it as an issue
say_en.note: Synthesizes only what you have already discussed

say_en.text: List the test seams and confirm them with me before writing the spec
say_en.note: It checks the seams with you before publishing
